version: LOCK 84 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - The gossip at the square
builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

a.text: Three people at the square are talking about Layla: where does a widow get money for a second loom? Someone winks. They look at you to join in.

choices.label: Say you'd rather not talk about her

stop.text: There's an awkward pause. Then someone talks about the weather.

join.text: By evening a story is going round the market. Layla doesn't know where it started.
